mapper.insert: insert into warehouse_record(warehouse_id, staff_id, source, warehouse_time, status, del_flag, create_by, remark, create_time) values (#{warehouseId}, #{staffId}, #{source}, #{warehouseTime}, #{status}, 0, #{createBy}, #{remark}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select * from warehouse_record where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0

select wr.*, w.name as warehouse_name, s.name as staff_name from warehouse_record wr left join warehouse w on wr.warehouse_id = w.id left join staff s on wr.staff_id = s.id where wr.id = #{id} and wr.del_flag = 0
